items.prompt: Black to move. Find a strong move.

claims.statement: The engine's best move (Stockfish 19 lite, depth 16) is Qe6; the accepted moves Qe6 and Rhe8 are within 30 cp of it.

After Qe6 the queen on e6 attacks 11 such squares.

hints: List your pieces and ask which one has the worst job, or which feature of the position you could use.

A queen makes the move.
items.explain: Engine evidence (Stockfish 19 lite, depth 16, one thread): Qe6 is the top choice; Rhe8 is within 30 cp of it. Qe6 improves the queen: it attacks 6 squares not held by Black's own pieces from d7 and 11 from e6. Rule of thumb, not proved by the engine: a piece that reaches more squares can do more; the move that most improves the worst-placed piece is often a good quiet move.
